object.script:
INTV=61 MAX_INTV=INTV UPLOAD_TABLE={}
pitchUp=true
function onTick() I,O=input,output GN,GB=I.getNumber,I.getBool P=property PN,PB,PT=P.getNumber,P.getBool,P.getText value="" started=GB(1)
if INTV%10==1 and started then p1,p2,p3=GN(1),GN(2),GN(3) if p2>-5 then value = string.format("%.2f,%.2f,%.2f", p1, p2, p3) table.insert(UPLOAD_TABLE, value) end end
nowPitch=GN(4) if nowPitch<0.125 and pitchUp then output.setNumber(1, 1) elseif nowPitch>0.125 then pitchUp=false output.setNumber(1, -1) elseif nowPitch>-0.125 and not pitchUp then output.setNumber(1, -1) elseif nowPitch<-0.125 then pitchUp=true output.setNumber(1, 1) end
if INTV==1 then if started and #UPLOAD_TABLE > 0 then upload_value=table.concat(UPLOAD_TABLE, "|||") async.httpGet(5588, string.format("/send?value=%s", upload_value)) UPLOAD_TABLE={} end INTV=MAX_INTV else INTV=INTV-1 end end
function onDraw() end
function httpReply(port, request_body, response_body) end

object.script:
setAltitude=9 targets={} sweepSpacing=300 sweepCorner=nil zoom=1 started=false
prevGpsX,prevGpsY,prevAlt,prevCompass=0,0,0,0 havePrevState=false altErrI=0 oCol,oPitch,oYaw=0,0,0 holdX,holdY,wasPressed,justReleased=0,0,false,false
routeTotal=0 routeRemain=0 routePct=0 routeEta=-1
function dist(x,y)return math.sqrt(x*x+y*y)end function clamp(x,a,b)if x<a then return a elseif x>b then return b else return x end end function normAng(a)while a>math.pi do a=a-math.pi*2 end while a<-math.pi do a=a+math.pi*2 end return a end
function calcRemainingRouteDistance(fx,fy) if #targets==0 then return 0 end local d=dist(targets[1][1]-fx,targets[1][2]-fy) for i=1,#targets-1 do d=d+dist(targets[i+1][1]-targets[i][1],targets[i+1][2]-targets[i][2]) end return d end
function formatEta(sec) if not sec or sec<0 then return "---:--" end local t=math.floor(sec+0.5) local m=math.floor(t/60) if m>999 then m=999 end return string.format("%03d:%02d",m,t%60) end
function resetRouteStats() routeTotal,routeRemain,routePct,routeEta=0,0,0,-1 end
function addSweepLine(out,horizontal,fixed,minV,maxV,reverse) if horizontal then table.insert(out,reverse and {maxV,fixed} or {minV,fixed}) table.insert(out,reverse and {minV,fixed} or {maxV,fixed}) else table.insert(out,reverse and {fixed,maxV} or {fixed,minV}) table.insert(out,reverse and {fixed,minV} or {fixed,maxV}) end end
function buildSweep(minX,maxX,minY,maxY,step,horizontal,startHigh,reverseFirst) local out,axis={},{} if horizontal then local y=minY while y<maxY do table.insert(axis,y) y=y+step end if #axis==0 or math.abs(axis[#axis]-maxY)>0.001 then table.insert(axis,maxY) end else local x=minX while x<maxX do table.insert(axis,x) x=x+step end if #axis==0 or math.abs(axis[#axis]-maxX)>0.001 then table.insert(axis,maxX) end end local i0,i1,di=1,#axis,1 if startHigh then i0,i1,di=#axis,1,-1 end local line=0 for i=i0,i1,di do local reverse=(line%2==1)~=reverseFirst if horizontal then addSweepLine(out,true,axis[i],minX,maxX,reverse) else addSweepLine(out,false,axis[i],minY,maxY,reverse) end line=line+1 end return out end
function generateSweepTargets(x1,y1,x2,y2,spacing) targets={} local minX,maxX=math.min(x1,x2),math.max(x1,x2) local minY,maxY=math.min(y1,y2),math.max(y1,y2) local width,height=maxX-minX,maxY-minY local step=math.max(1,spacing) if width<1 and height<1 then table.insert(targets,{x2,y2}) return end local horizontal=width>=height local refX,refY=(gpsX or x1),(gpsY or y1) local bestPath,bestD=nil,1e30 for _,startHigh in ipairs({false,true}) do for _,reverseFirst in ipairs({false,true}) do local p=buildSweep(minX,maxX,minY,maxY,step,horizontal,startHigh,reverseFirst) local d=dist(p[1][1]-refX,p[1][2]-refY) if d<bestD then bestD,bestPath=d,p end end end targets=bestPath or targets end
function onTick() local SN,GN=output.setNumber,input.getNumber
gpsX,gpsY,alt=GN(10),GN(11),GN(13) compass=-GN(14)*math.pi*2 targetAlt,targetX,targetY=GN(15),GN(16),GN(17) started=input.getBool(32)
if not havePrevState then prevGpsX,prevGpsY,prevAlt,prevCompass=gpsX,gpsY,alt,compass havePrevState=true end vx,vy,altRate=gpsX-prevGpsX,gpsY-prevGpsY,alt-prevAlt prevGpsX,prevGpsY,prevAlt=gpsX,gpsY,alt yawRate=normAng(compass-prevCompass) prevCompass=compass
local tx,ty=targetX,targetY if #targets>0 then tx,ty=targets[1][1],targets[1][2] end distance=dist(tx-gpsX,ty-gpsY) direction=math.atan(tx-gpsX,ty-gpsY) if #targets>1 and distance<12 then local sx,sy=targets[2][1]-targets[1][1],targets[2][2]-targets[1][2] if dist(sx,sy)>1 then direction=math.atan(sx,sy) end end
if #targets>0 then if routeTotal<=0 and started then routeTotal=calcRemainingRouteDistance(gpsX,gpsY) end routeRemain=calcRemainingRouteDistance(gpsX,gpsY) routePct=routeTotal>0 and clamp((1-routeRemain/routeTotal)*100,0,100) or 0 local gs=dist(vx,vy)*60 routeEta=(started and gs>0.15) and (routeRemain/gs) or -1 else routeRemain,routePct,routeEta=0,100,0 if not started then routeTotal=0 end end
if started then local dd=normAng(direction-compass) local da=targetAlt-alt local yawCmd=dd*0.62 if math.abs(dd)>0.12 and math.abs(yawCmd)<0.18 then yawCmd=dd>0 and 0.18 or -0.18 end oYaw=clamp(yawCmd,distance<8 and -0.55 or -0.90,distance<8 and 0.55 or 0.90) altErrI=clamp(altErrI+da*0.005,-0.35,0.35) local yawLift=(math.abs(oYaw)*0.10+math.abs(yawRate)*0.04)*(da<0 and 1 or 0.65) oCol=clamp(da*0.14+altErrI-altRate*1.20-yawLift,-0.50,0.45) if distance<10 and math.abs(dd)>0.9 then oCol=clamp(oCol-0.05,-0.50,0.45) end if da>0.4 then local minCol=clamp(0.04+da*0.05,0.04,0.22) if oCol<minCol then oCol=minCol end end
local fwd=vx*math.sin(direction)+vy*math.cos(direction) local brakeDis=4+fwd*fwd*14 local wantFwd=distance<brakeDis and clamp((distance-2)*0.10,-0.25,0.70) or clamp(distance*0.15,0,2.40) oPitch=clamp((wantFwd-fwd)*0.66,-0.38,0.6) if oPitch>0 then local pitchLiftComp=oPitch*0.16+fwd*0.02 oCol=clamp(oCol+pitchLiftComp,-0.50,0.45) end if da<-0.8 then oCol=clamp(oCol+da*0.025,-0.50,0.45) end if distance<brakeDis and math.abs(dd)<0.80 and fwd>wantFwd+0.10 then local brakePitch=clamp(-0.16-(fwd-wantFwd)*0.45,-0.45,-0.16) if oPitch>brakePitch then oPitch=brakePitch end end if distance<4 then oPitch=clamp(oPitch,-0.30,0.20) end if math.abs(dd)>1.0 then oPitch=clamp(oPitch,-0.20,0.20) end
if #targets>0 and (distance<3.2 or (distance<6 and math.abs(fwd)<0.35)) then table.remove(targets,1) if #targets==0 then routeRemain,routePct,routeEta=0,100,0 end end else altErrI,oCol,oPitch,oYaw=0,-0.5,0,0 end
SN(1,oCol) SN(2,oPitch) SN(3,oYaw) output.setBool(32,started and #targets>0) end
function onDraw() local w,h=screen.getWidth(),screen.getHeight() screen.drawMap(gpsX,gpsY,zoom) screen.setColor(255,255,255) screen.drawText(2,2,string.format("P:%d%%",math.floor(routePct+0.5))) screen.drawText(2,8,"ETA:"..formatEta(routeEta)) for i=1,#targets do local px,py=map.mapToScreen(gpsX,gpsY,zoom,w,h,targets[i][1],targets[i][2]) screen.setColor(122,0,0) if i==1 then screen.drawLine(w/2,h/2,px,py) else local lpx,lpy=map.mapToScreen(gpsX,gpsY,zoom,w,h,targets[i-1][1],targets[i-1][2]) screen.drawLine(lpx,lpy,px,py) end end end
